review_evidence: axioms.lisp, defthm.lisp, defuns.lisp, prove.lisp, rewrite.lisp, induct.lisp, tau.lisp, translate.lisp, and type-set-*.lisp are core ACL2 implementation/formal-system source.
save-gprof.lsp is profiling/build infrastructure but defines the unique save-profiling-image function and therefore fails the hard-exclusion content-invariant despite its low retrieval priority.
Build files, HTML, licenses, and other clearly nonformal root material are already classified non-primary, so no additional lossless primary exclusion was found in this unit.
summary: Reviewed the ACL2 root-file unit. The retained Lisp sources implement ACL2's logic, proof engine, translation, rewriting, induction, type reasoning, parallel/runtime support, and related interfaces; operational files with named implementation functions are retained because hard exclusion would not be content-lossless.
